# vaultfolio.pro - AI Navigation Guide

## About
Vaultfolio is a multi-chain Web3 portfolio dashboard for European investors. Track native assets, ERC-20 tokens, NFTs and DeFi positions across 19 chains including Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, BSC, Blast, Celo, Cronos, Fantom, Gnosis, Kava, Linea, Mantle, Moonbeam, Moonriver, Scroll, and zkSync.

## Priority Sections
1. / - Portfolio tracking features and dashboard
2. /pricing - Tier comparison (Free, Pro $9/mo, Whale $29/mo)
3. /success - Post-purchase confirmation

## Feature Summary
- Multi-chain portfolio tracking (19 chains)
- ERC-20 token balances with real-time prices (CoinGecko)
- NFT gallery with metadata
- DeFi position tracking (Aave, Compound, LP tokens)
- 24h P&L history with charts
- Price alerts via email
- CSV/JSON/Koinly tax export
- Multi-wallet support (tier-gated)
- White-label embed for agencies
- Read-only, no private keys, zero signatures
